snippet.title: Bound Together - Official Trailer | Co-op Puzzle Game for 2 Players
snippet.description:
Bound Together is a first-person co-op puzzle game for two players. You start in separate rooms: each player sees clues the other cannot, and the only way out is to describe, listen and trust each other.

- Online co-op for 2 players, proximity voice chat and walkie-talkies
- Every match is randomized: the solutions change each time
- A prologue and three chapters: dungeons, a forge, a winter garden, a computer centre, a laser vault, endless backup offices and a stone quarry

Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9ND2N95NGM5Z
Website: https://nexusgames.expertrobitv.dev
Discord: https://discord.gg/SsaryhbwFA

Nexus Games Studios
